units.i2v_prompt: Single continuous take at 24fps, 16:9. A close-up at eye level; the camera eases in from almost still on a slow level move, gathering pace gently and settling as it arrives. A young man at a rooftop parapet holding a white paper plane back by its tail, the dusk city far below, his fringe moved by the rising wind. Warm 2000 Taiwanese telecine grade, warm skin tones, milky lifted blacks. Visible 35mm film grain. Restrained continuous motion, camera and subject motion only.
